---
name: Update Track
description: "Reconcile an active LoopDev track with implementation evidence, approved decisions, phases, risks, and validation."
argument-hint: "Track id or path"
agent: agent
---

Use the `track-governance` skill to update the requested active track. Review its current phase and
repository evidence. Ask for explicit approval before recording any change of scope, architecture,
contracts, sequencing, risks, or closure criteria. Regenerate and validate the dashboard.
